added_failure_basis: The reviewed run's manifest carries no readable suite pair: 'baseline_suite:' and 'after_suite:' are both empty, and its write paths hold no test file, so the suite was unarmed and no suite verdict exists to compare. Derived from those two (absent) arms the added-failure set is empty, not zero-measured; no pytest run was substituted for the unarmed pair.

findings.summary: Four of the twelve panels fix their floor at zero through 'ax.set_ylim(0, max(values) * 1.15)' and put their width-64 point on that floor, so the stage costs the ranked list has to judge read as zero on the deliverable figure. Recomputed from h200/audited.json: at width 64 host scheduling gaps are 24.4980/64 = 0.3828 ms on a panel topping at 30.576 ms (1.25% of the axis), transfers and fills 1.3573/64 = 0.0212 ms on a panel topping at 1.344 ms (1.6%), other and fused 6.6553/64 = 0.1040 ms on a panel topping at 2.889 ms (3.6%), and predictor 0.0064/64*1000 = 0.100 us on a panel topping at 5.446 us (1.8%). The numbers in the fragment's table are correct; the figure a reader opens cannot show them. The figure review of this run at the same head records the same defect, so one repair answers both.

The measurement input is read from an absolute path inside another run's directory (r-20261112T182638024068-h200-levers/h200-levers-corrected/common-streams.npz) and nothing in the repository regenerates it, so the digest the receipts record (52f8d4fb9e60dbdbe1530e8b64a171d3bb6470fb5cf73a1ddcf760895d09a0e9) names bytes that a run-directory prune would destroy. Verified today: the file is present and its digest matches, so the evidence is sound as filed; the exposure is that this node's whole measurement cannot be repeated once that peer run is pruned, and the driver fails at an assert rather than rebuilding the input. Name the generator, commit a small recipe, or copy the input under a durable cache root.

findings.disposition: folded into a later node that re-runs or re-attributes this profile after support_read.py changes
findings.summary: The branch attribution resolves 'Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / nova/equilibrium/support_read.py' from the tree that runs the report, not from the revision the traces were captured at, and matches HLO frame line numbers against it. Each receipt already records the measured module path in its 'module' field, and nothing compares the two. Correct for this run because the measured revision 0d9c849 and the reporting tree 279beff carry an identical support_read.py (git diff --stat 0d9c849 5f868e16 -- nova/ is empty), but a later edit above the carry function shifts terminal.lineno, the 'frame["line"] == terminal.lineno' rule never fires, and kernels executed in the terminal full-commit certificate fall through to the carry rule and are charged to carried geometry, inflating the regression the fragment attributes.

justifications.durability: There is no test file in the node's scope, so nothing re-runs the guards: measure.py:13 refuses a closure gap above 10% and measure.py:237 refuses a dominant-stage omission, but report.py:17 binds its HLO line-number attribution to whatever support_read.py the driver's own tree carries rather than to the measured revision.
justifications.evidence: Every number in the fragment's three tables reconciles exactly against h200/audited.json and the per-arm receipt.json files (for example carried launches 526 to 898 and device activity 2.522 to 7.816 ms are reproduced from historical-read-16-{1,2} and main-read-16-{1,2}), and measure.py:11-13, measure.py:213-241 and report.py:128-171 refuse an incomplete or omitted stage inventory.
justifications.fit: scripts/prototypes/bank_h200_slice_profile follows the sibling prototypes' measure/report/job naming and their save_checked and plot conventions, and its comments describe mechanism (report.py:44-46 explains the false certificate branch) with no plan or ticket label anywhere in the diff.
justifications.goal_fidelity: scripts/prototypes/bank_h200_slice_profile/measure.py:1-382 measures the whole slice and its stages, and the fragment's ranked list at bank-h200-slice-profile.html:57-61 names four changes with cost, saving and verification, but the widest admitted width stops at 64 because run.py:145 never probes between 64 and 256.
justifications.reuse: The instrument imports scripts.prototypes.bank_solve_trace.analyse and overrides its group function rather than copying it, reuses save_checked from bank_solve_profile/plot.py and machine()/scaled_profile() from bank_newton_step and bank_warm_start, and adds only the branch-aware relabelling; the read-versus-update split it re-derives parallels scripts/prototypes/bank_solve_trace_head/report.py:45 invocations, which it does not extend.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat a732ede0a545a4c6524cfd3ccfb1fbc6aa125642 5f868e16a4e51c34a60160be6d7da29df7640427 lists six added files totalling 3089 insertions and no modification to nova/equilibrium/support_read.py or any test.
